entity.summary: `:common` entity coverage is a thin slice of Bukkit/Paper/Spigot: base `Entity` has location/velocity read/teleport/remove but lacks motion control, orientation, naming, passengers, visibility flags, and proximity queries. `LivingEntity`/`Damageable`/`Player` omit equipment, combat, absorption, respawn, and flight-permission APIs that plugins use constantly. Highest ROI is closing these core gameplay gaps with Adventure-typed names and small inventory bridges (`EntityEquipment`, `HumanEntity`) rather than per-mob interfaces.

world.summary: :common` world coverage is read-heavy: block/chunk lookup, dimensions, border, environment/difficulty/time reads, and entity/player enumeration. Bukkit exposes large gameplay surfaces still absent—ray tracing (despite RayTraceResult existing), spatial queries, entity spawn/lookup, block mutation/light/biome, weather/time/spawn/explosion control, chunk generation/force-load flags, and animated world-border changes. Adding ~15 domain-agnostic methods plus FluidCollisionMode and HeightMap enums would unlock most cross-platform plugin patterns without touching event/scheduler APIs.

block.summary: `:common` block coverage is thin: `BlockType` is key-only, `BlockState` mirrors only Bukkit `BlockData` as a string (not tile `BlockState`), and `world.Block` lacks mutation, lighting, redstone, drops/breaking, placement checks, and biome APIs. The highest-value additions are block mutation, richer `BlockState`/`BlockData` properties, lighting/redstone queries, drop/break helpers, tile-state access, and small supporting enums.

void setState(@NotNull BlockState state);
void setState(@NotNull BlockState state, boolean applyPhysics);
gaps.reason: Placing/changing blocks is one of the most common plugin operations; adapters already wrap `BlockData` as `BlockState` but expose no write path.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitBlockWrapper, MinestomBlockWrapper

gaps.methodSignature:
void setType(@NotNull BlockType type);
void setType(@NotNull BlockType type, boolean applyPhysics);

gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitBlockWrapper, MinestomBlockWrapper

gaps.reason: Custom mining, vein miners, and loot-preview UIs need server-accurate drop simulation without actually breaking the block.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitBlockWrapper, MinestomBlockWrapper

gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitBlockWrapper, MinestomBlockWrapper

gaps.methodSignature: boolean canPlace(@NotNull BlockState state);

gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitBlockWrapper, MinestomBlockWrapper

gaps.reason: Current `BlockState` only exposes `type()` and `asString()`; these properties are essential for lighting engines, tool checks, and state editing without string parsing.

gaps.methodSignature: long blockKey();
gaps.reason: Packed block keys are used for efficient maps/sets and chunk-local indexing in performant block trackers.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitBlockWrapper, MinestomBlockWrapper

gaps.methodSignature: float breakSpeed(@NotNull Player player);
gaps.reason: Mining UX, haste/fatigue plugins, and custom tool abilities need player-specific break speed at a block.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitBlockWrapper (Minestom: approximate via block hardness + player attributes)

gaps.methodSignature: enum PistonMoveReaction { NORMAL, DESTROY, BLOCK, IGNORE, PUSH_ONLY }
gaps.reason: Piston/contraption plugins need a portable enum for how a block reacts to piston movement.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitBlockStateWrapper (+ Block wrapper passthrough); MinestomBlockStateWrapper

effect.summary: `:common` effect coverage is thin: six marker-like types with almost no behavior, no `Sound` type, no world particle/sound APIs, and no dedicated Bukkit effect wrappers (anonymous implementations in `BukkitLivingEntityWrapper`). Highest-value additions are registry-backed `Sound`, world `spawnParticle`/`playSound`, richer potion/enchantment metadata, and adapter conversion helpers so plugins can drive visuals and status effects without Bukkit types.

gaps.methodSignature: interface Sound extends net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed {}
gaps.reason: Sound is referenced everywhere (World/Player/LivingEntity hurt/eat/drink sounds) but `:common` has no keyed sound abstraction; plugins must use raw Adventure keys or platform types.
gaps.adapterImpact: Add `BukkitSoundWrapper` (or registry lookup) and `Sound`/`toBukkit(Sound)` in `BukkitAdapters`; Paper can reuse Bukkit mapping.

void spawnParticle(@NotNull Particle particle, @NotNull Location location, int count);

gaps.reason: Particle effects are one of the most common cross-platform gameplay utilities; `World` currently exposes no visual-effect API despite Bukkit exposing many overloads.
gaps.adapterImpact: Extend `BukkitWorldWrapper` and `PaperWorldWrapper`; add `Particle` conversion in `BukkitAdapters`. Minestom needs `MinestomWorldWrapper` particle bridge.

gaps.methodSignature: void playSound(@NotNull Location location, @NotNull Sound sound, @NotNull SoundCategory category, float volume, float pitch);
gaps.bukkitSignature: void playSound(org.bukkit.Location, org.bukkit.Sound, org.bukkit.SoundCategory, float, float)
gaps.reason: Ambient/world sound playback is domain-agnostic and widely used for feedback, minigames, and ambience; only `SoundCategory` exists today.
gaps.adapterImpact: Extend `BukkitWorldWrapper`/`PaperWorldWrapper`; map `SoundCategory` via existing enum and new `Sound` adapter.

gaps.methodSignature: @Nullable PotionEffect potionEffect(@NotNull PotionEffectType type);
gaps.reason: Plugins frequently read amplifier/duration of a single active effect; only `hasPotionEffect` and the full collection are exposed.
gaps.adapterImpact: Add to `BukkitLivingEntityWrapper` and `MinestomLivingEntityWrapper`; reuse shared `BukkitPotionEffectWrapper` instead of anonymous classes.

gaps.methodSignature:
boolean addPotionEffect(@NotNull PotionEffect effect, boolean force);

gaps.methodSignature: @NotNull PotionEffect createEffect(int duration, int amplifier);
gaps.reason: Canonical factory for building effects from a type; avoids duplicating duration/amplifier/ambient defaults at every call site.
gaps.adapterImpact: Implement on `BukkitPotionEffectTypeWrapper`; Minestom registry-backed implementation.

gaps.reason: Infinite/beacon-style effects and immutable `with*` copies are standard Bukkit patterns used in buff systems and item builders.

gaps.methodSignature: enum PotionEffectTypeCategory { BENEFICIAL, HARMFUL, NEUTRAL }
gaps.reason: Category drives UI coloring, brewing logic, and whether an effect is treated as a debuff; `PotionEffectType` lacks this metadata.
gaps.adapterImpact: Add `PotionEffectType.category()` and map in `BukkitPotionEffectTypeWrapper`.

gaps.methodSignature: @NotNull PotionEffectTypeCategory category();
gaps.reason: Pairs with the new category enum; required for effect classification in domain-agnostic code.
gaps.adapterImpact: Implement on `BukkitPotionEffectTypeWrapper`.

gaps.reason: Enchantment display and applicability checks are core to anvil/grindstone/custom-enchant plugins; current interface only exposes level bounds and curse/treasure flags.
gaps.adapterImpact: New `BukkitEnchantmentWrapper` plus `Enchantment`/`toBukkit(Enchantment)` in `BukkitAdapters`; used by future `ItemStack` enchantment helpers.

gaps.methodSignature:
boolean isTradeable();
boolean isDiscoverable();

gaps.adapterImpact: Add to `BukkitEnchantmentWrapper`.

gaps.reason: Typed particles (block dust, item, color) require knowing the data payload class before calling `World.spawnParticle`; marker `Particle` is insufficient.
gaps.adapterImpact: Add `BukkitParticleWrapper`; validate `data` argument type in world spawn helpers.

gaps.reason: `Biome` exists in `:common` but is unused; biome get/set on blocks is a standard worldgen/gameplay effect primitive.

ItemMeta attribute coverage is partial (no per-slot bulk ops). Minestom adapter stubs modifier APIs entirely.

gaps.methodSignature: void addTransientModifier(@NotNull AttributeModifier modifier)
gaps.reason: Transient modifiers are the standard way to apply temporary buffs/debuffs (potions, abilities) without persisting on save; adapters currently only expose permanent addModifier.

gaps.methodSignature: double defaultValue()

gaps.methodSignature: void removeModifier(@NotNull Key key)

gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitAttributeInstanceWrapper; MinestomLivingEntityWrapper

server.summary: `:common` server coverage is thin (13 methods on `Server`, 4 on `CommandSender`) versus ~230 `org.bukkit.Server` APIs. The highest-value additions are version/identity lookups, command dispatch, thread/tick introspection, offline-player identity, inventory factory methods, MOTD/broadcast variants, and closing Adventure messaging gaps in adapters. Scheduler, plugin manager, scoreboard, boss bar, recipe, and Paper-Folia region APIs are intentionally deferred.

gaps.methodSignature: @NotNull String minecraftVersion();
gaps.reason: Nearly every cross-version plugin gates behavior on the Minecraft release string; `version()` alone returns the Bukkit implementation string, not the game version.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitServerWrapper, PaperServerWrapper (delegate to `getBukkitServer().getMinecraftVersion()`). Future MinestomServerWrapper maps to Minestom protocol/version.

gaps.methodSignature: boolean dispatchCommand(@NotNull CommandSender sender, @NotNull String commandLine);
gaps.reason: Core server primitive for running console/plugin commands from gameplay code without touching Bukkit command maps directly.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitServerWrapper (unwrap `CommandSender` via `BukkitAdapters.toBukkit(sender)`), PaperServerWrapper inherits. New Minestom adapter would route to Minestom command manager.

gaps.methodSignature: @Nullable org.aincraft.common.entity.Entity entity(@NotNull UUID uniqueId);
gaps.reason: UUID entity lookup is the standard way to resolve dropped items, mobs, and players across worlds without holding live references.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitServerWrapper + PaperServerWrapper (`BukkitAdapters.adapt(getEntity(uuid))`). Requires existing `BukkitEntityWrapper` path.

gaps.methodSignature: boolean isPrimaryThread();
gaps.reason: Thread-safety guard used everywhere on Bukkit/Paper before mutating worlds or entities; domain-agnostic and essential for portable utilities.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitServerWrapper, PaperServerWrapper. Minestom equivalent would compare against the instance process thread.

gaps.methodSignature: int currentTick();
gaps.reason: Lightweight server clock for cooldowns, delays, and diagnostics without pulling in Bukkit's scheduler API.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitServerWrapper, PaperServerWrapper. Minestom maps to `MinecraftServer.getTick()`.

gaps.methodSignature:
@NotNull OfflinePlayer offlinePlayer(@NotNull UUID uniqueId);
@NotNull OfflinePlayer offlinePlayer(@NotNull String name);
gaps.reason: Offline identity is required for bans, whitelist, stats, and UUID resolution (`getPlayerUniqueId`) and is one of the most-used Server lookups after online player queries.
gaps.adapterImpact: New `BukkitOfflinePlayerWrapper`; Server methods in BukkitServerWrapper/PaperServerWrapper. Minestom needs a profile/offline-player bridge.

gaps.methodSignature:
@Nullable org.aincraft.common.entity.Player playerExact(@NotNull String name);
@NotNull java.util.Collection<? extends org.aincraft.common.entity.Player> matchPlayers(@NotNull String partialName);
gaps.reason: Complements existing `player(String)` (case-insensitive) with exact-name and partial-match lookups used by commands and tab completion.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitServerWrapper, PaperServerWrapper (adapt player collections via `BukkitAdapters`).

gaps.methodSignature:
@NotNull org.aincraft.common.world.GameMode defaultGameMode();
void setDefaultGameMode(@NotNull org.aincraft.common.world.GameMode gameMode);
gaps.reason: Server-wide default gamemode is a common lobby/minigame setting; `:common` already owns `GameMode`.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitServerWrapper, PaperServerWrapper (enum mapping between common and Bukkit `GameMode`).

gaps.methodSignature:
@NotNull net.kyori.adventure.text.Component motd();
void motd(@NotNull net.kyori.adventure.text.Component motd);
gaps.reason: MOTD is a first-class Adventure `Component` on modern Paper; fits the Kyori-first `:common` policy and is widely read/written by lobby plugins.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitServerWrapper (Paper native `motd()`), PaperServerWrapper inherits. Legacy Spigot may need serializer fallback for set.

gaps.methodSignature: int broadcast(@NotNull net.kyori.adventure.text.Component message, @NotNull String permission);
gaps.reason: Permission-scoped broadcast is the standard way to send staff/admin messages without iterating `onlinePlayers()` manually.
gaps.adapterImpact: PaperServerWrapper (native Adventure broadcast). BukkitServerWrapper should gain a Paper-aware path or legacy fallback; return recipient count.

gaps.methodSignature:
@NotNull org.aincraft.common.inventory.Inventory createInventory(@Nullable org.aincraft.common.inventory.InventoryHolder holder, int size, @NotNull net.kyori.adventure.text.Component title);
@NotNull org.aincraft.common.inventory.Inventory createInventory(@Nullable org.aincraft.common.inventory.InventoryHolder holder, @NotNull org.aincraft.common.inventory.InventoryType type);
gaps.reason: Virtual GUI creation is one of the most common server-side operations and belongs on `Server` rather than forcing plugins to reach for Bukkit directly.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitServerWrapper + `BukkitInventoryWrapper`; unwrap holder via adapters. Paper can pass Adventure title natively.

gaps.methodSignature: void savePlayers();
gaps.reason: Explicit player-data flush before shutdown/reload is a common admin utility and is domain-agnostic persistence.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitServerWrapper, PaperServerWrapper direct delegate.

gaps.methodSignature: boolean onlineMode();
gaps.reason: Online-mode flag drives UUID/skin/auth behavior; frequently checked in portable auth and proxy-aware plugins.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitServerWrapper, PaperServerWrapper. Minestom exposes equivalent via connection/auth config.

gaps.methodSignature: @NotNull Server server();
gaps.reason: Command handlers routinely need the server instance; every `CommandSender` (console, players, proxied senders) exposes this on Bukkit.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitCommandSenderWrapper (return adapted server from `sender.getServer()`). Player wrappers can override to avoid re-wrap cost.

gaps.methodSignature: void sendMessage(@NotNull net.kyori.adventure.text.Component message);
gaps.reason: `CommandSender` extends `Audience`, but `BukkitCommandSenderWrapper` serializes to legacy section strings, losing formatting on Paper and diverging from `PaperServerWrapper` which already uses native Adventure.
gaps.adapterImpact: Add `PaperCommandSenderWrapper` (delegate `sendMessage(Component)` natively); keep legacy fallback in `BukkitCommandSenderWrapper` for plain Spigot. Update `BukkitAdapters.adapt(CommandSender)` to select Paper wrapper when available.

newInterfaces.name: OfflinePlayer
newInterfaces.reason: Minimal offline identity contract backing `Server.offlinePlayer(...)`, whitelist/ban checks, and UUID resolution without importing Bukkit's `OfflinePlayer` or profile types.

location.summary: `:common` location types are read-only coordinate views (Location, Position, BoundingBox) with minimal defaults. Bukkit exposes rich vector math on `org.bukkit.util.Vector`, spatial transforms and queries on `org.bukkit.Location`, and box mutation/ray-trace on `org.bukkit.util.BoundingBox`. The largest coverage holes are Vector3d arithmetic, Location direction/offset/nearby-entity helpers, BoundingBox expand/shift/union/rayTrace, and a Rotation/HeightMap pair for orientation and height sampling. Adapters today wrap Bukkit Vector as Position only, and BoundingBox.intersects() does not delegate to Bukkit overlaps().

gaps.reason: Bukkit collapses position and direction into Vector with full 3D math. Plugins constantly use normalize/cross/add for knockback, projectiles, and facing. Vector3d today only exposes accessors, length, distance, and dot.
gaps.adapterImpact: Add BukkitVector3dWrapper (or make BukkitPositionWrapper implement Vector3d); add MinestomVector3dWrapper backed by Vec/Point; extend BukkitAdapters/MinestomAdapters with adapt/toBukkit conversions.

gaps.methodSignature: @NotNull Vector3d direction();
gaps.reason: getDirection() is one of the most-used Location APIs (spawn offsets, velocity, ray origins). No common equivalent exists; callers must reimplement yaw/pitch trigonometry.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitLocationWrapper delegates to getDirection() via Vector3d adapter; MinestomLocationWrapper computes from Pos yaw/pitch.

gaps.reason: Immutable-style transforms are needed because :common interfaces are views, while Bukkit Location is mutable. Teleport targets, spawn builders, and pathing all offset/rotate locations frequently.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitLocationWrapper and MinestomLocationWrapper return new wrapper instances (clone/add on Bukkit; Pos.withView on Minestom). Paper adapter inherits Bukkit behavior.

gaps.methodSignature:
@NotNull Location toBlockLocation();
@NotNull Location toCenterLocation();
gaps.reason: Block-aligned and block-center snapping are standard for placement, particles, and region math. Current Location only exposes blockX/Y/Z getters without producing adjusted locations.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitLocationWrapper delegates directly; MinestomLocationWrapper uses block/center Pos helpers.

gaps.reason: Spatial entity queries from a point are core gameplay utilities (auras, traps, proximity checks). World.entities() is world-wide and not a substitute.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitLocationWrapper delegates and wraps entities via existing entity wrappers; MinestomLocationWrapper uses instance entity queries near Pos.

gaps.reason: Region growth around selections and hitboxes is a primary BoundingBox use case. Common BoundingBox is query-only (contains/intersects) with no mutation/expansion API.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitBoundingBoxWrapper and MinestomBoundingBoxWrapper return new box wrappers from platform expand calls.

gaps.reason: Moving selections and merging/intersecting volumes are standard for protection regions, collision broadphase, and structure bounds.
gaps.adapterImpact: Update BukkitBoundingBoxWrapper and MinestomBoundingBoxWrapper to delegate shift/union/intersection.

gaps.methodSignature: @Nullable RayTraceResult rayTrace(@NotNull Vector3d origin, @NotNull Vector3d direction, double maxDistance);
gaps.reason: RayTraceResult already exists in :common.world but BoundingBox cannot perform the trace. Needed for line-of-sight and projectile intersection against AABBs.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitBoundingBoxWrapper delegates and maps to common RayTraceResult; MinestomBoundingBoxWrapper uses Minestom collision raycast APIs.

gaps.methodSignature:
@NotNull Location toHighestLocation();
@NotNull Location toHighestLocation(@NotNull HeightMap heightMap);
gaps.reason: Snapping to highest solid block is widely used for safe teleport and surface finding. Requires a platform-agnostic HeightMap enum in :common.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitLocationWrapper delegates; MinestomLocationWrapper uses chunk height/surface queries; add HeightMap mapping in both adapters.

gaps.methodSignature: enum HeightMap { MOTION_BLOCKING, MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES, OCEAN_FLOOR, WORLD_SURFACE, WORLD_SURFACE_WG }
gaps.bukkitSignature: org.bukkit.HeightMap MOTION_BLOCKING, MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES, OCEAN_FLOOR, WORLD_SURFACE, WORLD_SURFACE_WG
gaps.reason: toHighestLocation(HeightMap) cannot be expressed in :common without a shared height-sampling enum.
gaps.adapterImpact: Map enum values in BukkitAdapters; provide Minestom equivalent height strategy per value.

gaps.reason: Paper exposes rotation as a first-class type; yaw/pitch pairs are used independently of position for cameras, mounts, and teleport. Cleaner than duplicating float pairs across APIs.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitLocationWrapper maps Paper Rotation when available; MinestomLocationWrapper maps Pos view; optional Location.rotation() accessor.

gaps.methodSignature:
@NotNull Vector3i add(int x, int y, int z);
@NotNull Vector3i subtract(@NotNull Vector3i other);
gaps.reason: Integer block-coordinate arithmetic is common for schematic offsets and chunk-relative math. Vector3i is read-only today and no BlockVector adapter exists.
gaps.adapterImpact: Add BukkitVector3iWrapper and MinestomVector3iWrapper; wire through BukkitAdapters/MinestomAdapters.

gaps.methodSignature:
boolean isChunkLoaded();
long toBlockKey();
gaps.reason: Chunk-loaded checks prevent unsafe block access; toBlockKey() is a compact block identity used in maps and palette systems.
gaps.adapterImpact: BukkitLocationWrapper delegates; MinestomLocationWrapper uses instance chunk-loaded check and packs block coords into long.

gaps.methodSignature: implements Vector3d (or dedicated BukkitVector3dWrapper)
gaps.reason: BukkitAdapters.adapt(Vector) returns Position, discarding mutable vector behavior. Any Vector3d API added to :common cannot be reached from Bukkit without a Vector3d-capable wrapper.
gaps.adapterImpact: Refactor BukkitPositionWrapper to implement Vector3d or split Position/Vector3d wrappers; update BukkitAdapters adapt/toBukkit overloads. Minestom needs parallel Vector3d wrapper.

gaps.methodSignature: boolean intersects(@NotNull BoundingBox other) should delegate to org.bukkit.util.BoundingBox.overlaps
gaps.reason: Current intersects() reimplements AABB logic in Java instead of delegating to Bukkit, risking divergence from platform edge cases and missing future Bukkit fixes.
gaps.adapterImpact: Update BukkitBoundingBoxWrapper.intersects() to call boundingBox.overlaps() when other is a Bukkit wrapper; keep fallback for foreign BoundingBox implementations.

newInterfaces.name: Rotation
newInterfaces.reason: Models yaw/pitch independently of position; aligns with Paper Rotation and Location rotation helpers without pulling Paper types into :common.

newInterfaces.name: HeightMap
newInterfaces.reason: Platform-agnostic height sampling strategy required by Location.toHighestLocation(HeightMap); maps directly to org.bukkit.HeightMap.
